metadata.title: Positivity of simplicial volume of convex projective manifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $\Omega$ be an irreducible properly convex projective domain admitting a discrete cocompact group action of projective automorphisms. We prove that the Holmes--Thompson volumes of projective simplices with vertices in $\Omega$ are uniformly bounded. As a consequence, we prove that a closed properly convex projective manifold of dimension at least two has positive simplicial volume if and only if it is irreducible.
